Third-party JavaScript used by the avatar preview in Freya's window.

These files are copied unmodified from the packages below, as published on
the npm registry. Each package's tarball was checked against the registry's
published SHA-512 before unpacking. Do not edit them; to update, replace them
with files from a newer release and update this list.
